description.zh:
是否在返回结果中包含PublicKey。
默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include PublicKey in the response.
Default value: false.

description.zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC 4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法。更多详情，请参见[RFC 4716](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716)。
description.en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The fingerprint uses the message-digest algorithm 5 (MD5) based on the public key fingerprint format defined in RFC 4716. For more information, see [RFC 4716](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4716).

description.zh:
密钥对名称。支持正则表达式模糊搜索，使用*匹配子表达式，示例：

- `*SshKey`：查询以SshKey结尾的密钥对名称，包括SshKey。
- `SshKey*`：查询以SshKey开头的密钥对名称，包括SshKey。
- `*SshKey*`：查询名称中间有SshKey的密钥对，包括SshKey。
- `SshKey`：精确匹配SshKey。
description.en:
The name of the key pair. You can use regular expressions for fuzzy search, with the asterisk (*) to match child table expressions. Examples:

- `*SshKey`: searches for key pair names that end with SshKey, including SshKey.
- `SshKey*`: searches for key pair names that start with SshKey, including SshKey.
- `*SshKey*`: searches for key pair names that contain SshKey, including SshKey.
- `SshKey`: exact match of SshKey.

description.zh:
密钥对列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1 。
description.en:
The page number of the key pair list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10 。
description.en:
The number of entries per page in paging queries. Settings: Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 密钥对所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the key pairs. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
密钥对所在的企业资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the key pairs belong. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

description.zh:
密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用[ListTagResources](~~110425~~)接口进行查询。
description.en:
The tag key of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that are attached with all specified tags cannot exceed 1000. If the resource count exceeds 1000, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation to query resources.

description.zh: 密钥对的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-key-pairs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name 0SshKey0 --key-pair-finger-print ABC1234567 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --include-public-key false --resource-group-id rg-amnhr7u7c7hj0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeKeyPairs --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairFingerPrint ABC1234567 --KeyPairName 0SshKey0 --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-amnhr7u7c7hj0000' --PageNumber 1 --IncludePublicKey false --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
